topic: How multi-factor authentication stops most account takeovers, and why phishing-resistant passkeys go further

request.audience: all employees, non-technical, in a corporate security awareness programme
request.notes: Technical but plain. Show the mechanism running: what a password proves, what a second factor adds, how a phishing page relays codes, why a passkey cannot be relayed. Use a magnifier on the login exchange and a cutaway of the phone or key. No invented statistics.
